query: SELECT id, title, slug, imageUrl, imageKey FROM artworks WHERE title LIKE '%Cheetah%' AND (collectionId = (SELECT id FROM collections WHERE slug = 'in-progress') OR collectionId = (SELECT id FROM collections WHERE slug = 'work-in-progress')) ORDER BY createdAt DESC LIMIT 5;
